escalations.why: tests/contracts/test_interface.py::test_step_stub_has_its_signature_and_names_its_task[train.config-load_run_configs-path seeds-M1-T02] asserts load_run_configs still raises NotImplementedError('M1-T02'), so no implementation of M1-T02 can pass the gate. STUBS has no link to open tasks in tasks/todo.md; the row should drop (or be filtered) once its task replaces the stub, and the same will block every other stub-replacing task (M1-T03, T05, T07...). Signature check (path seeds) still holds. Implementation and unit tests are done in src/rllab/train/config.py and tests/unit/rllab/test_config.py (12 pass); the only gate failure is this protected contract test.

tests/contracts/test_interface.py::test_step_stub_has_its_signature_and_names_its_task (make_learner, load_policy) and ::test_step_class_has_its_constructor_and_names_its_task (DQN) assert that every M1 stub still raises NotImplementedError naming its task, unconditionally. Any task that replaces its stub, as M1-T08 must, fails them; they should check only stubs whose task is still open in tasks/todo.md (or only the signature once a task is done). The gate runs tests/contracts, so no non-interface task can pass. M1-T08 is otherwise complete: DQN, make_learner, load_policy and 16 unit tests pass, and mypy, ruff, size, deptry, import-linter and floor_guard are clean. These 3 parametrized cases are the only failures.

tests/contracts/test_interface.py::test_step_stub_has_its_signature_and_names_its_task (frozen, protected) asserts every step in STUBS, including train.check check_plan/train_checks/score_checks/require_pass (M1-T03), still raises NotImplementedError naming its task when called with None args. Any task that replaces its stub (the job of M1-T02..M1-T29) fails it: with check.py implemented, check_plan(None) raises TypeError. The test should check only the signature once the named task is no longer open in tasks/todo.md (or drop the raise check for landed tasks). M1-T03's implementation and unit tests are in the worktree (src/rllab/train/check.py, tests/unit/rllab/test_check.py; 14 unit tests pass, ruff/mypy/size/deptry/import-linter pass); only this frozen contract test blocks the gate.

tests/contracts/test_interface.py (frozen, protected): test_step_stub_has_its_signature_and_names_its_task[train.loop.run-train_loop-...-M1-T09] and test_step_class_has_its_constructor_and_names_its_task[runlog.writer-RunWriter-...-M1-T09] assert pytest.raises(NotImplementedError, match=task) for every stub, so they fail as soon as the owning task replaces its stub; no implementing task can pass check.sh gate (pytest -x over tests/contracts). The stub assertion should apply only while the named task is open in tasks/todo.md (as check.sh gate's CR-02 check already does), or keep only the signature/constructor-parameter assertion. M1-T09 is implemented in src/rllab/train/loop/run.py and src/rllab/runlog/writer.py with tests/unit/rllab/test_loop.py (12 passing); every other gate step passes.

tests/contracts/test_interface.py::test_step_stub_has_its_signature_and_names_its_task[evaluate.final.play-final_evaluation-runs out workers-M1-T17] calls final_evaluation(None, None) and requires NotImplementedError('M1-T17'): it asserts the stub is still a stub, so it fails for any implementation of M1-T17 (and the same holds for every STUBS/CLASSES row once its task lands). tests/contracts/test_interface.py::test_step_class_has_its_constructor_and_names_its_task[worlds.checks-CheckDiscrete-overrides-M1-T04] (and its STUBS/CLASSES siblings) asserts the class still raises NotImplementedError('M1-T04'), so it fails as soon as M1-T04 replaces the stub, as the task requires. tests/contracts/test_interface.py::test_step_stub_has_its_signature_and_names_its_task[methods.factory-make_learner|load_policy-M1-T08] and test_step_class_has_its_constructor_and_names_its_task[methods.dqn.learner-DQN-M1-T08] call each step with None arguments and require NotImplementedError('M1-T08'), i.e. that the stub is still a stub. They can only pass while M1-T08 is unimplemented, so every task replacing a stub (M1-T08 and all others listed in STUBS/CLASSES) fails the gate. The signature half of each test is right; the NotImplementedError half should apply only to stubs whose task is still open in tasks/todo.md (or be dropped, since check.sh gate already enforces CR-02 stub naming). M1-T08 implementation is complete otherwise: mypy, ruff, size, deptry, import-linter, floor_guard clean; 20 unit tests in tests/unit/rllab/test_dqn.py and all other contract tests pass.

tests/contracts/test_interface.py::test_step_stub_has_its_signature_and_names_its_task (frozen at the base, protected) asserts every step in STUBS still raises NotImplementedError naming its task, unconditionally, with no filter on open tasks in tasks/todo.md. Replacing a stub, which is the task, therefore always fails the gate: with check_plan/train_checks/score_checks/require_pass implemented (src/rllab/train/check.py, 15 unit tests in tests/unit/rllab/test_check.py passing; every other gate step clean), the 4 train.check rows fail (check_plan(None) raises TypeError). The same holds for test_step_class_has_its_constructor_and_names_its_task, test_each_entry_module_has_its_smoke_run and the main-dispatch test for every later task. Suggested fix: keep the signature assertion, and assert NotImplementedError only while the named task is open in tasks/todo.md (or drop the raise check once a task lands).

tests/contracts/test_interface.py::test_step_stub_has_its_signature_and_names_its_task[train.loop.run-train_loop-...-M1-T09] and test_step_class_has_its_constructor_and_names_its_task[runlog.writer-RunWriter-...-M1-T09] assert the stub still raises NotImplementedError naming its task, unconditionally (STUBS/CLASSES are not filtered to tasks still open in tasks/todo.md). Replacing a stub, which is the task's whole job, makes the gate's 'pytest tests/unit tests/contracts' fail; every implementing task (M1-T02..T29) will hit the same. Suggested fix (protected file, interface/build-setup Revise): keep the signature/constructor assertion but only check the NotImplementedError when the named task is still open, or skip the raise check once the body no longer is a stub. M1-T09 implementation is complete in the worktree: src/rllab/train/loop/run.py, src/rllab/runlog/writer.py, tests/unit/rllab/test_loop.py (12 unit tests pass; ruff, mypy, size, deptry, import-linter, floor_guard all pass).
